expected: Quantum computers will one day forge the signatures that guard every crypto wallet today. Magen is a wallet built for that day. Get it from the site, for Chrome or for iPhone.
transcript: Quantum computers will one day forge the signatures that guard every crypto wallet today. Magen is a wallet built for that day. Get it from the site for Chrome or for iPhone.

expected: Load the Chrome extension, and open it. It's the same wallet in your browser, with a live demo account to look around.
transcript: Load the Chrome extension and open it. It's the same wallet in your browser with a live demo account to look around.

expected: On iPhone, the app opens to the same wallet.
transcript: On iPhone, the app opens to the same wallet.

expected: Now create a wallet. Pick a name. Then twelve words: your one backup, for every chain.
transcript: Now create a wallet, pick a name, then 12 words, your one backup for every chain.

expected: Those twelve words make your address on Bitcoin, Zcash, Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Solana and Cosmos, plus a quantum safe key, M L D S A sixty five.
transcript: Those 12 words make your address on Bitcoin, Zcash, Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Solana, and Cosmos, plus a Quantum SafeKey, MLDS65.

expected: One transaction gives the new account two locks on Near: your key, and the quantum safe one. Review it, and approve.
transcript: One transaction gives the new account two locks on near, your key and the quantum safe one. Review it and approve.

expected: On the explorer: the wallet contract, deployed with both keys.
transcript: On the Explorer, the wallet contract deployed with both keys.

expected: Ten test Near from the testnet helper, and every chain's address, from one seed.
transcript: 10 tests near from the testnet helper and every chain's address from one seed.

expected: Now a wallet I've used all day. Unlock it with its password.
transcript: Now a wallet I've used all day. Unlock it with its password.

expected: Bring Bitcoin in. This is the wallet's own Bitcoin deposit address. Two deposits arrived, and each was minted as n B T C on Near.
transcript: Bring Bitcoin in. This is the wallet's own Bitcoin deposit address. Two deposits arrived, and each was minted as NBTC on near.

expected: Here is the mint on Near, and the Bitcoin payment it came from, sent earlier from a testnet wallet.
transcript: Here is the mint on near, and the Bitcoin payment it came from, sent earlier from a testnet wallet.

expected: Zcash works the same way. A testnet deposit to this address became n Z E C on Near.
transcript: Zcash works the same way. A testnet deposit to this address became NZEC on near.

expected: Swap half a Near for U S D T on Ref Finance. The approval shows everything: network, signer, four calls in one batch, and two signatures, classical and quantum safe.
transcript: Swap half a near for USDT on REF Finance. The approval shows everything. Network, signer, four calls in one batch, and two signatures, classical and quantum safe.

expected: The Near network checked both signatures before the swap ran.
transcript: The near network checked both signatures before the swap ran.

expected: Bridge out, to this wallet's own Solana address, through the Omni bridge. Same approval, same two signatures. Approve, and the bridge relays it.
transcript: Bridge out to this wallet's own Solana address through the Omni Bridge. Same approval, same two signatures. Approve and the bridge relays it.

expected: It starts on the Near network, and lands on Solana's dev net.
transcript: It starts on the near network and lands on Solana's DevNet.

expected: Private send. Pay someone without linking the payment to their account. The money goes to a one time account that only they can open.
transcript: Private send pays someone without linking the payment to their account. The money goes to a one-time account that only they can open.

expected: On chain, it's a payment to a fresh account, nothing more.
transcript: On Chain, it's a payment to a fresh account, nothing more.

expected: Back on the new wallet. Lose your phone, and guardians can help: any two of three can move your locks to a new device. Setting them up is signed twice, too.
transcript: Back on the new wallet, lose your phone and guardians can help. Any two of three can move your locks to a new device. Setting them up is signed twice too.

expected: And when classical keys stop being safe, flip the Q Day switch. It adds your quantum safe key to the account itself, as a native Near key.
transcript: And when classical keys stop being safe, flip the Q-Day switch. It adds your quantum safe key to the account itself as a native near key.

expected: The Near network now lists a post quantum key on this account, and the explorer marks it quantum safe.
transcript: The near network now lists a post quantum key on this account, and the explorer marks it quantum safe.

expected: The iPhone app carries the same two locks. Send shows exactly what you sign, and both signatures, before anything leaves the phone. Approve, and Near verifies both.
transcript: The iPhone app carries the same two locks. Send shows exactly what you sign and both signatures before anything leaves the phone. Approve and near verifies both.

expected: Here's that payment on the explorer.
transcript: Here's that payment on the Explorer.

expected: One seed. Every chain. A quantum safe lock on every move, and real bridges in and out. That's Magen, on Near testnet today.
transcript: One seed, every chain, a quantum safe lock on every move and real bridges in and out. That's Magin on Near Testnet today.
